en: Charge phones and power banks before the storm.
Prepare a go-bag: water, food, flashlight, first-aid kit, medicines and copies of IDs.
Know your evacuation center and follow barangay and CDRRMO announcements.
Do not walk or drive through floodwater.
Turn off the main electric switch if water enters the house.
fil: I-charge ang cellphone at power bank bago dumating ang bagyo.
Maghanda ng go-bag: tubig, pagkain, flashlight, first-aid kit, gamot at kopya ng mga ID.
Alamin ang inyong evacuation center at sundin ang abiso ng barangay at CDRRMO.
Huwag lumusong o magmaneho sa baha.
Patayin ang main switch ng kuryente kapag pumasok ang tubig sa bahay.

en: Drop, Cover and Hold On under a sturdy table.
Stay away from windows, shelves and falling objects.
If outside, move to an open area away from buildings, posts and wires.
After the shaking stops, check for injuries, gas leaks and electrical hazards.
Expect aftershocks and follow official advisories.
fil: Lumuhod, magtakip at kumapit (Drop, Cover, Hold) sa ilalim ng matibay na mesa.
Lumayo sa bintana, estante at mga bagay na maaaring mahulog.
Kung nasa labas, pumunta sa bukas na lugar na malayo sa gusali, poste at kable.
Kapag tumigil ang pagyanig, tingnan kung may sugatan, tagas ng gas o panganib sa kuryente.
Maghanda sa aftershock at sundin ang opisyal na abiso.

en: Shout "Fire!" and call the BFP right away.
Stay low under the smoke and leave quickly.
Do not use elevators.
Never go back inside a burning building.
If clothes catch fire: stop, drop and roll.
fil: Sumigaw ng "Sunog!" at tumawag agad sa BFP.
Dumapa o yumuko sa ilalim ng usok at lumabas agad.
Huwag gumamit ng elevator.
Huwag bumalik sa loob ng nasusunog na gusali.
Kung masunog ang damit: huminto, dumapa at gumulong.

en: Traditional jeepney: PHP 14 minimum, plus PHP 2 for each succeeding km.
Modern jeepney: PHP 17 minimum, plus PHP 2.30 for each succeeding km.
Fares were approved by the LTFRB in March 2026 and reported again in September 2026. Operators must post a fare matrix inside the vehicle.
Confirm the amount for your route with the driver's posted matrix or the LTFRB.

Modern na dyip: PHP 17 minimum, dagdag PHP 2.30 sa bawat susunod na km.

Kumpirmahin ang pamasahe sa inyong ruta sa nakapaskil na fare matrix ng driver o sa LTFRB.
